hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $in.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -like '*.cs' -and $f -notlike '*\\obj\\*' -and $f -notlike '*\\bin\\*') { dotnet build 'D:\MotelyJAML\Motely.slnx' --no-restore -v q --nologo 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 12; exit $LASTEXITCODE }"

pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $in.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -match '[\\/]Seeds[\\/].*\.csv$') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('The seed lake stays truthful when SeedLakeSink is its only author — run the search (or --makeitrain) to grow this file.'); exit 2 }"
